name: Villanueva (La Guajira, Colombia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a white band, teal green above and below.
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva, a municipality in the department of La Guajira, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
